title: DimGrow: Memory-Efficient Field-level Embedding Dimension Search
abstract: arXiv:2505.12683v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Key feature fields need bigger embedding dimensionality, others need smaller. This demands automated dimension allocation. Existing approaches, such as pruning or Neural Architecture Search (NAS), require training a memory-intensive SuperNet that enumerates all possible dimension combinations, which is infeasible for large feature spaces. We propose DimGrow, a lightweight approach that eliminates the SuperNet requirement. Starting training model from one dimension per feature field, DimGrow can progressively expand/shrink dimensions via importance scoring. Dimensions grow only when their importance consistently exceed a threshold, ensuring memory efficiency. Experiments on three recommendation datasets verify the effectiveness of DimGrow while it reduces training memory compared to SuperNet-based methods.

translated_title: DimGrow：内存高效的特征字段级嵌入维度搜索
translated_abstract: 关键特征字段需要更大的嵌入维度，而其他字段则需要更小的维度，这就要求自动化的维度分配。现有方法，如剪枝或神经架构搜索（NAS），需要训练一个内存密集型的超级网络来枚举所有可能的维度组合，这对于大规模特征空间来说是不可行的。我们提出了DimGrow，这是一种轻量级方法，摆脱了对超级网络的需求。DimGrow从每个特征字段一个维度开始训练模型，通过重要性评分逐步扩展或收缩维度。只有当维度的重要性持续超过阈值时才会增长，从而确保内存效率。在三个推荐数据集上的实验验证了DimGrow的有效性，同时与基于超级网络的方法相比，它降低了训练内存。
tldr: DimGrow是一种无需内存密集型超级网络的轻量级嵌入维度搜索方法，通过重要性评分从单维度起步逐步扩展或收缩各特征字段的嵌入维度，在保证推荐效果的同时显著降低训练内存。
en_tdlr: DimGrow is a lightweight embedding dimension search method that eliminates the memory-intensive SuperNet by progressively growing or shrinking per-field embedding dimensions based on importance scoring, achieving effective recommendation performance with significantly reduced training memory.
